title: oncidium × lueroroides
intro: Oncidium × lueroroides, commonly known as Luer's oncidium, is a hybrid orchid species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Luer's oncidium include its use as a treatment for coughs, colds, and respiratory infections, as well as its potential to act as an antioxidant and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of Oncidium × lueroroides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
